title: KLineage: Recovering the Missing When of Kernel Optimization by Deoptimizing Experts
abstract: arXiv:2605.28213v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: LLM-based agents are increasingly used to generate GPU kernels, but they often struggle to determine when an optimization is sound because its required code state and dependencies are implicit in expert implementations. We introduce KLineage, which learns this missing "when" knowledge from expert kernels: instead of relying on forward rollouts, KLineage walks expert implementations backward through validation-gated simplifications and reverses each accepted step into a reusable optimization skill. Each skill records not only the optimization intent, but also when to apply the optimization technique, including where it applies in code, what conditions made it valid, what effect it has, and what failures its assumptions avoid. A downstream LLM materializes these skills on new code surfaces under the same compile/correctness/profile gate. This guidance on when to apply each optimization can help downstream models to generate higher-perf

translated_title: KLineage：通过反优化专家实现来恢复内核优化中缺失的“何时”知识
translated_abstract: 基于LLM的智能体正被越来越多地用于生成GPU内核，但它们常常难以判断一项优化何时是合理的，因为其所需的代码状态和依赖关系隐含在专家实现之中。我们提出KLineage，它从专家内核中学习这种缺失的“何时”知识：KLineage不依赖前向推演，而是通过带验证门控的简化步骤逆向遍历专家实现，并将每个被接受的步骤反转为一个可复用的优化技能。每个技能不仅记录优化的意图，还记录何时应用该优化技术，包括它在代码中的适用位置、使其成立的条件、它产生的效果，以及其假设可以避免哪些失败。下游LLM在相同的编译/正确性/性能剖析门控下，将这些技能实例化到新的代码上。这种关于何时应用每项优化的指导可以帮助下游模型生成更高性能的内核（原文此处截断）。
tldr: KLineage通过逆向“反优化”专家内核实现，把专家经验中隐含的“何时应用优化”知识提取为记录适用位置、成立条件、效果与可避免失败的可复用优化技能，从而指导下游LLM生成更高性能的GPU内核。
en_tdlr: KLineage recovers the missing "when" knowledge of kernel optimization by walking expert kernels backward through validation-gated deoptimization and reversing each step into reusable optimization skills, enabling downstream LLMs to generate higher-performance GPU kernels.
